title: PDE-State Conditioning for Learned Optimization Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) optimization depends on global properties of the underlying PDE and how the physics residual evolves across the domain. Standard optimizers such as Adam use fixed gradient-based statistics, while learned PINN optimizers replace the fixed rule with a learned update built from local parameters and optimization-history features. However, none explicitly use PDE-level information. We study two coupled design questions: what PDE-level information should a learned optimizer observe, and how should that information influence its update? We introduce an 11-dimensional PDE state-capturing operator structure, residual geometry, and short-horizon update response, and use it to condition a structured meta-learned optimizer through bounded feature-wise modulation. translated_title: 基于物理信息神经网络的学习优化中的PDE状态条件化
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）的优化依赖于底层偏微分方程（PDE）的全局性质以及物理残差在整个定义域上的演化方式。诸如Adam等标准优化器使用固定的基于梯度的统计量，而学习型PINN优化器则用由局部参数和优化历史特征构建的学习式更新规则来替代固定规则。然而，这些方法均未显式地利用PDE层面的信息。我们研究了两个相互耦合的设计问题：学习型优化器应当观测哪些PDE层面的信息，以及这些信息应如何影响其更新？我们引入了一个11维的PDE状态，用以刻画算子结构、残差几何和短时程更新响应，并通过有界的逐特征调制（feature-wise modulation）将其用于条件化一个结构化的元学习优化器。反复开展的设计研究表明，在所有被测试的方案中，紧凑的残差几何状态G2与有界的FiLM是综合表现最强的选择。
tldr: 该论文提出用11维PDE状态（刻画算子结构、残差几何与短时程更新响应）通过有界FiLM调制来条件化元学习优化器，使学习型PINN优化器首次显式利用PDE层面信息，并通过设计研究确定紧凑残差几何状态G2与有界FiLM为最佳设计组合。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an 11-dimensional PDE state capturing operator structure, residual geometry, and short-horizon update response, which conditions a structured meta-learned optimizer via bounded FiLM modulation, enabling learned PINN optimizers to explicitly exploit PDE-level information, with the compact residual-geometry state G2 and bounded FiLM identified as the strongest design choices.
